audience: UK employers and managers who use Go2Clock for clocking, timesheets and rotas

useCases.title: Check clock-ins for a day or week
useCases.text: List the clock records of one day, or of a range of up to 7 days, with the name and shift of each user.

useCases.title: Export a timesheet report
useCases.text: Generate the timesheet CSV for up to 7 days, for everyone or for one department or employee.

useCases.title: Read an employee's rota
useCases.text: Read the rota of one employee between two dates, with shift names and planned hours per day.

useCases.title: Put a shift on an employee's rota
useCases.text: Put a named shift on the rota from a start date, for one or more days. An existing rota entry on the same date is replaced.

useCases.title: Add a missed clock record
useCases.text: Add one clock record for an employee. Go2Clock refuses a duplicate record.

useCases.title: Update employee details
useCases.text: Change some details of one employee, or upload a list of new and changed employees. Passwords and roles are not changed.
